name: al-lsp-for-agents
description: Code navigation, call hierarchy, and code quality diagnostics for AL (Business Central) — works with GitHub Copilot agent mode

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_goToDefinition
languageModelTools.userDescription: Navigate to where an AL symbol is defined
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate to where an AL symbol is defined. Provide a file URI and either a symbolName (preferred) or a line/character position. When using symbolName, the tool automatically finds the correct position via documentSymbol.

symbolName.description: Name of the symbol to look up (e.g. 'ExportAsXML', 'CreateCustomer'). Preferred over line/character.

line.description: Zero-based line number (fallback if symbolName not provided)

character.description: Zero-based character offset (fallback if symbolName not provided)

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_hover
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get type info, signatures, and field lists for AL symbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get type information, procedure signatures, and record field lists for an AL symbol. Provide a file URI and either a symbolName (preferred) or a line/character position. When using symbolName, the tool automatically finds the correct position.

symbolName.description: Name of the symbol to look up (e.g. 'ExportAsXML', 'CustomerRec'). Preferred over line/character.

line.description: Zero-based line number (fallback if symbolName not provided)

character.description: Zero-based character offset (fallback if symbolName not provided)

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_findReferences
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find all usages of an AL symbol across the project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find all usages of an AL symbol across the project. Provide a file URI and either a symbolName (preferred) or a line/character position. Use this before renaming or modifying a symbol to understand impact.

symbolName.description: Name of the symbol to look up. Preferred over line/character.

line.description: Zero-based line number (fallback if symbolName not provided)

character.description: Zero-based character offset (fallback if symbolName not provided)

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_prepareCallHierarchy
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get call hierarchy item at a cursor position
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a call hierarchy item for an AL procedure. Provide a file URI and either a symbolName (preferred) or a line/character position on the procedure name.

symbolName.description: Name of the procedure. Preferred over line/character.

line.description: Zero-based line number (fallback if symbolName not provided)

character.description: Zero-based character offset (fallback if symbolName not provided)

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_incomingCalls
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find all callers of an AL procedure
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find all procedures that call a specific AL procedure (its callers). Provide a file URI and either a symbolName (preferred) or a line/character position on the procedure name.

symbolName.description: Name of the procedure. Preferred over line/character.

line.description: Zero-based line number (fallback if symbolName not provided)

character.description: Zero-based character offset (fallback if symbolName not provided)

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_outgoingCalls
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find all procedures called by an AL procedure
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find all procedures that a specific AL procedure calls (its callees). Provide a file URI and either a symbolName (preferred) or a line/character position on the procedure name.

symbolName.description: Name of the procedure. Preferred over line/character.

line.description: Zero-based line number (fallback if symbolName not provided)

character.description: Zero-based character offset (fallback if symbolName not provided)

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_codeLens
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get reference counts for procedures in an AL file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get reference counts for all procedures in an AL file. Returns code lens items showing how many callers each procedure has. Use this to quickly identify unused or heavily-used procedures.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_codeQualityDiagnostics
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get code quality diagnostics: unused procs, complexity, etc.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get code quality diagnostics for AL files: unused procedures (no callers), high cyclomatic complexity, too many parameters, high fan-in, and long methods. Use this to identify code smells and improvement opportunities. Optionally filter by file URI.

uri.description: File URI (file:///path/to/file.al) to filter diagnostics for a specific file, or omit for all files

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_documentSymbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the symbol tree for an AL file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the symbol tree for an AL file. Returns all objects, procedures, fields, actions, and variables with their hierarchy. Use this to understand file structure before reading or editing.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_renameSymbol
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename an AL symbol across all files in the workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rename an AL symbol across all files in the workspace. Provide a file URI, either a symbolName (preferred) or line/character position, and the new name.

symbolName.description: Name of the symbol to rename. Preferred over line/character.

line.description: Zero-based line number (fallback if symbolName not provided)

character.description: Zero-based character offset (fallback if symbolName not provided)

newName.description: The new name for the symbol

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_symbolRelations
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find how an AL object relates to others (extends, implements, source table, extended by)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get related symbols for an AL object: outgoing relations (SourceTable, TableRelation, Implements, Extends, ExtensionOf) and incoming relations (ExtendedBy, ImplementedBy, UsedAsSourceTable). Provide symbolName plus symbolKind (Table, Page, Codeunit, Interface, Enum). Covers dependencies, not just workspace source.

symbolKind.description: Table, Page, Codeunit, Interface, Enum, etc.

languageModelTools.name: bclsp_inspectPage
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect a Business Central page's control tree or action tree
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect a Business Central page layout (areas, groups, fields, parts) or action hierarchy. Provide pageName and content='Controls' (default) or 'Actions'. Resolves pages defined in dependencies (e.g. 'Customer Card'). Requires the AL build tools; if unavailable the tool reports how to install them.

alLspForAgents.enableCodeQualityDiagnost.description: Show code quality diagnostics from al-call-hierarchy in the editor (unused procedures, high complexity, too many parameters, high fan-in, long methods). Disabled by default — enable to see inline warnings.

alLspForAgents.verboseDiagnosticLogging.description: Debug: log every diagnostic received by the middleware (source, code, severity, message). Used to investigate issue #15/#17. Enable, reproduce the bug, then copy the 'AL LSP for Agents' output channel.
